definition.lead: Medicinal chemistry designs, makes and optimizes the molecules that become medicines.
definition.body: It sits between synthesis, biology and pharmacology. Medicinal chemists adjust a molecule's structure until it binds its target, reaches it in the body, lasts long enough and stays safe. Most small-molecule drugs on the market came out of this cycle.

timeline.title: Morphine
timeline.text: Friedrich Sertürner reports the isolation of morphine from opium.
timeline.why: The first active ingredient isolated from a medicinal plant.

timeline.title: Aspirin
timeline.text: Chemists at Bayer prepare pure, stable acetylsalicylic acid.
timeline.why: A synthetic modification of a natural remedy.

timeline.title: The magic bullet
timeline.text: Paul Ehrlich's team introduces Salvarsan against syphilis.
timeline.why: The first modern chemotherapy designed to hit a pathogen.

timeline.title: Penicillin
timeline.text: Alexander Fleming notices mould killing bacteria.
timeline.why: Opened the antibiotic era once it was mass-produced in the 1940s.

timeline.title: Sulfa drugs
timeline.text: Gerhard Domagk shows that the dye Prontosil cures bacterial infections.
timeline.why: The first broadly effective synthetic antibacterials.

timeline.title: The first beta-blocker
timeline.text: Propranolol, developed by James Black's team, reaches patients.
timeline.why: A drug designed from receptor theory.

timeline.title: Statins
timeline.text: Lovastatin is approved in the United States.
timeline.why: A new class of cholesterol-lowering drugs.

timeline.title: The rule of five
timeline.text: Christopher Lipinski publishes simple limits linked to oral absorption.
timeline.why: Shaped how drug candidates are designed.

timeline.title: Targeted cancer therapy
timeline.text: Imatinib is approved for chronic myeloid leukaemia.
timeline.why: Showed that a drug can target the exact molecular cause of a cancer.

timeline.title: Curing hepatitis C
timeline.text: Sofosbuvir is approved in the United States.
timeline.why: Part of oral treatments that cure most hepatitis C infections.
